outcome: Reproductive outcomes (pregnancy rate, rates of biochemical and ectopic pregnancies, miscarriages, ongoing/delivered pregnancies)
cohort: 103 patients with secondary infertility undergoing ovarian stimulation for IVF/ICSI who had a history of one or more previous caesarean sections and an ultrasonographically visible isthmocele
finding: Patients with an existing isthmocele after previous caesarean section have a ~40% risk of developing ultrasonographically visible fluid in the endometrial cavity during ovarian stimulation, and this risk is correlated with isthmocele characteristics and obstetric history.
mod_finding: This study found that women with an isthmocele after previous cesarean section have a nearly 40% risk of developing intracavitary fluid during hormonal stimulation for IVF.
